name: cavemio-avatar
title: Avatar
description: A face, or initials until there is one: the photo rises out of a blur once it has loaded, and a stack of avatars fans open when you point at it.

cavemio.accessibility:
- role="img" with the name (and status) as its label.
- Reduced motion: the photo fades without blur; the stack doesn't fan.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

useCases.title: Team and member lists
useCases.description: A face, name and status in each row.

features.title: No broken images
features.description: Initials first; the photo replaces them only once loaded, cached ones included.

features.title: Presence
features.description: online, away, busy, offline as a dot with a background ring.

states.title: loaded
states.description: The photo fades in from a 6px blur at 1.08 (360–520ms).

states.title: group hover
states.description: The overlap opens to a 4px gap; +N rolls when it changes.
